{"title":"Daily AI Info (1/2)","elements":[[{"tag":"text","text":"News"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"要闻"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"1. "},{"tag":"text","text":"豆包计划推出专业版 辟谣降体验推会员传闻"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
豆包 官方宣布计划推出“豆包专业版”，目前尚处测试阶段。官方承诺日常基础功能保持免费，并明确辟谣网传“降体验逼买会员”的不实说法。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/Be5hOIJUQC8ogxRy3epWLQ","text":"https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/Be5hOIJUQC8ogxRy3epWLQ"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"2. "},{"tag":"text","text":"Google 发布 Gemma 4 12B 原生多模态模型"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
Google DeepMind 发布 Gemma 4 12B 模型。它采用无编码器架构支持原生音视频输入，可在 16GB 内存笔记本本地运行多模态 Agent，现已基于 Apache 2.0 协议开源。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/introducing-gemma-4-12b/","text":"https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/introducing-gemma-4-12b/"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"模型发布"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"3. "},{"tag":"text","text":"Ideogram 发布开源图像模型 Ideogram 4.0"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
Ideogram 发布开源图像生成模型 Ideogram 4.0 。该模型参数量为 9.3B ，支持结构化 JSON 提示词和边界框布局控制，官方称其在多语言文本渲染和设计能力上达到业界领先水平，并在多个第三方基准测试中位居开源模型首位。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://ideogram.ai/blog/ideogram-4.0/","text":"https://ideogram.ai/blog/ideogram-4.0/"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"4. "},{"tag":"text","text":"Reve 发布 Reve 2.0 图像模型"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
AI 图像实验室 Reve 正式发布 Reve 2.0 图像模型。官方宣称该模型是世界最佳的 4K 图像模型，可通过精确布局控制图像生成与编辑，目前已于 今天 上线可用。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://x.com/reve/status/2062260665121919101","text":"https://x.com/reve/status/2062260665121919101"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"5. "},{"tag":"text","text":"OpenAI 升级生命科学模型 GPT-Rosalind"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
OpenAI 为专用于企业级生命科学研究的 GPT-Rosalind 推出大升级，整合了 GPT-5.5 的 agentic coding 与工具使用能力。官方称其在多项基准测试中表现领先，现正向全球符合资格的机构开放研究预览版。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://openai.com/index/introducing-new-capabilities-to-gpt-rosalind/","text":"https://openai.com/index/introducing-new-capabilities-to-gpt-rosalind/"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"6. "},{"tag":"text","text":"Nex AGI 发布并开源 Nex-N2-Pro 模型"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
Nex AGI 发布并开源模型 Nex-N2-Pro 。官方称其具备自适应推理能力，性能媲美前沿模型。该模型已在 硅基流动平台 提供 限时免费 调用。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://huggingface.co/nex-agi/Nex-N2-Pro","text":"https://huggingface.co/nex-agi/Nex-N2-Pro"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"7. "},{"tag":"text","text":"京东开源 JoyAI-Echo 长音视频生成框架"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
京东 Joy Future Academy 发布 JoyAI-Echo 框架，支持生成长达 5 分钟的连贯音视频，代码与权重已开源。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://github.com/jd-opensource/JoyAI-Echo","text":"https://github.com/jd-opensource/JoyAI-Echo"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"开发生态"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"8. "},{"tag":"text","text":"OpenAI 调整 Codex 验证规则，服务端现 429 故障"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
据社区反馈， OpenAI 疑似取消 Codex 强制手机二次验证，但仍有部分用户称需要验证，同时系统疑似灰度测试 Passkey 与邮件接码。还有用户观察到，有人密集在 OpenAI 官方论坛发布了关于跨区订阅等的举报。此外，北京时间 6月3日 ， OpenAI 服务端突发大规模故障， Codex 与 API 频繁出现报错， Codex 额度显示异常。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://status.openai.com","text":"https://status.openai.com"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"9. "},{"tag":"text","text":"Codex 宣布重置所有付费套餐使用额度"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
针对过去24小时内多起影响 Codex 可靠性的事件， Codex 负责人 Tibo 于 今日上午约8点半 宣布重置所有付费套餐使用额度。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://x.com/thsottiaux/status/2062329981548802523","text":"https://x.com/thsottiaux/status/2062329981548802523"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"10. "},{"tag":"text","text":"MiniMax 优化 M3 模型速度并开启 Token Plan 退款"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
MiniMax 宣布 本周五上午十点 前购买 Token Plan 的用户，将获 M3 周限额永久额外 百分之五十 的福利。官方上线专属自助售后平台接管答疑，控制台同步开放 Token Plan 退款通道，常规订单 本周内 处理完毕。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://platform.minimaxi.com/docs/token-plan/migration","text":"https://platform.minimaxi.com/docs/token-plan/migration"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"11. "},{"tag":"text","text":"OpenClaw 更新：新增 Skill Workshop 与原生 Windows 支持"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
OpenClaw 发布 2026.6.1 版本，新增 Skill Workshop 允许 Agent 将重复工作转化为可审查的复用技能，并正式引入原生 Windows 节点支持。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://openclaw.ai/blog/openclaw-agent-skill-workshop","text":"https://openclaw.ai/blog/openclaw-agent-skill-workshop"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"12. "},{"tag":"text","text":"讯飞上线星辰Token Plan包月订阅服务"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
讯飞 官方推出星辰Token Plan包月订阅服务，官方称支持多款旗舰模型与 讯飞核心能力 统一调用，提供 高峰不限流 及最高 500万 TPM吞吐保障。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

"},{"tag":"text","text":"Kimi 推出本地 Agent 产品 Kimi Work Beta 版"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
Kimi 官方推出本地 Agent 产品 Kimi Work Beta 版。该产品内核基于 Kimi Code ，最高支持 300 个子 Agent 并行协作，目前已开放 Mac 版下载， Windows 版即将上线。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

"},{"tag":"text","text":"千问向第三方 Agent 和 Skill 全面开放并开启首批测试"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
千问 宣布向第三方 Agent 和 Skill 全面开放。 瑞幸咖啡、肯德基 等首批企业正在测试并陆续上线，未来所有企业均可运营自定义品牌 Agent 。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

"},{"tag":"text","text":"QoderWork 升级高校福利：师生完成认证额外获 4000 积分"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
QoderWork 中国版面向 高校师生 推出专属福利，完成身份认证后可额外获得有效性 3 个月 的 4000积分 ，累计获得 6000 积分 。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

"},{"tag":"text","text":"Google Labs 发布 Dreambeans：利用 Google 数据生成生活故事"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
Google Labs 推出实验性应用 Dreambeans ，基于用户 Google 数据生成个性化“故事”，目前仅限符合条件的美国 Google AI Ultra 订阅用户使用。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/google-labs/dreambeans/","text":"https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/google-labs/dreambeans/"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"技术与洞察"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"17. "},{"tag":"text","text":"Anthropic：AI自主攻击行为涌现，MITRE ATT&CK框架亟待纳入Agent编排"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
Anthropic 发布报告指出，根据对过去一年内 832个 恶意账户的分析，攻击者正利用 AI 实施更自主的后入侵操作，现有风险评估方法和框架已不敷使用。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://www.anthropic.com/news/AI-enabled-cyber-threats-mitre-attack","text":"https://www.anthropic.com/news/AI-enabled-cyber-threats-mitre-attack"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"行业动态"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"18. "},{"tag":"text","text":"美国发布AI安全新规：鼓励发布前自愿受检且不设强制许可"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
美国 领导人签署《促进先进人工智能创新与安全》行政命令，建立针对前沿 AI模型 的自愿审查框架，鼓励开发商在公开发布前最多 30 天向 政府 提供访问权限，同时要求全面升级 联邦及关键基础设施 的网络防御。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2026/06/promoting-advanced-artificial-intelligence-innovation-and-security/","text":"https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2026/06/promoting-advanced-artificial-intelligence-innovation-and-security/"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"19. "},{"tag":"text","text":"OpenAI发布前沿AI治理蓝图 CEO赴华盛顿探讨公私合作"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
OpenAI 发布前沿 AI 治理蓝图，提议建立联邦安全框架。同时据报道，其 CEO Sam Altman 正前往 华盛顿 探讨 AI 监管公私合作，并拟推动建立向消费者分享 AI 经济收益的机制。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://openai.com/index/frontier-safety-blueprint/","text":"https://openai.com/index/frontier-safety-blueprint/"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"20. "},{"tag":"text","text":"Google Search 允许网站不被 AI Overviews 收录"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
据报道，应 英国 反垄断机构要求， Google 在 Search Console 中测试新控件，允许 英国 网站屏蔽其内容被生成式 AI 搜索使用，后续将向全球推广。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/search/new-controls-website-owners/","text":"https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/search/new-controls-website-owners/"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"21. "},{"tag":"text","text":"Suno 官宣获得超 4 亿美元 D 轮融资"}]]}

"},{"tag":"text","text":"OpenAI 计划将 Codex 核心能力整合进 ChatGPT"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
OpenAI 在近期的产品发布直播中提及将在未来几周把 Codex 核心能力整合进 ChatGPT ，用户无需切换产品即可在多平台调用 Agent ， ChatGPT 将升级为统一工作界面。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

"},{"tag":"text","text":"Google被曝向开发者付费购买代码库训练AI"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"摘要:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
据媒体报道， Google 正通过 Play Store 联系 Android 开发者，计划通过支付费用获取其私有代码库来训练 AI 模型。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Original Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

"},{"tag":"text","text":"Audio Interaction Model"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-06-03"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
该工作提出音频交互模型，基于SoundFlow框架实现流式感知-决策-响应闭环，构建260万条数据的StreamAudio-2M语料库和主动音频干预基准，使模型能实时理解声音、跟随指令并主动提供帮助。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
"},{"tag":"a","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05121","text":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05121"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"2. "},{"tag":"text","text":"TeleSWEBench: A Commit-Driven Benchmark for Evaluating LLM-Powered Software Engineering in Telecommunications"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-06-03"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
TeleSWEBench 是首个电信领域 commit 驱动基准，从 srsRAN 5G 仓库挖掘 734 个带单元测试的用例，并用 TeleJudge 层次 LLM 评判框架评估 AIDER、OpenHands 等工具，发现最强 agent 仅实现 25% 可交付变更，用于推动电信软件工程 agent 研究。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

"},{"tag":"text","text":"SAID: Accelerating Diffusion-Based Language Models via Scaffold-Aware Iterative Decoding"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-06-03"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
SAID 框架通过优先对骨架词去噪建立语义结构，再对细节词省步解码，结合置信度分层生成，在数学、代码和知识任务上将扩散语言模型 LLaDA 推理加速最高 9.1 倍且性能持平，代码已开源。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

"},{"tag":"text","text":"BEATS: Bootstrapping E-commerce Attribute Taxonomies for Search through Iterative Human-AI Collaboration"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-06-03"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
BEATS 提供迭代式人机协作框架，利用LLM生成商品属性分类并通过质检和本地专家标注循环优化，已在乐天台湾9大类2694子类生成67277属性并打标超540万商品，提升稠密检索效果。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

"},{"tag":"text","text":"Self-Reflective APIs: Structure Beats Verbosity for AI Agent Recovery"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Publish Date:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
2026-06-03"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"一句话总结:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
论文提出自反射API，在API验证失败时向AI代理返回机器可读的结构化修复建议，支持自动请求修复与重试；在10个对抗任务上，结构化建议使Anthropic模型任务完成率提升36.7-40.0个百分点，且成功令牌效率提高1.8-2.2倍，同时发布防泄漏审计脚本。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"

TRI 框架通过将错误推理段转化为填空任务，利用前缀-后缀-中间序列重排和符号验证器微调解码器模型，在推理时手术式修复受损环节，实现三项基准最优并减少 31.2% 的令牌消耗。"}],[{"tag":"hr"}],[{"tag":"text","text":"Link:"},{"tag":"text","text":"
